scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing SBD-REPO01 behind the core, the domain controllers it takes DNS and time from, and SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 administering it over SSH from VLAN 60.
scene.completeCaption: SBD-REPO01 serves a verified, dated snapshot on TCP 80, takes DNS and time from both domain controllers, and is administered only from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01. The Linux servers in courses 1.5 and 1.11 patch from it from their first day.

nodes.name: SBD-REPO01
nodes.title: SBD-REPO01 · 10.0.70.20
nodes.description: The Linux repository this course builds. Not domain-joined, it serves dated, signature-verified snapshots over HTTP on TCP 80 (F19) and accepts SSH only from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: The PDC emulator and the domain's time source from course 1.1, part 3. It answers SBD-REPO01's DNS queries (F01) and serves its time on UDP 123 through the row lesson 1 adds.

nodes.name: SBD-DC02
nodes.title: SBD-DC02 · 10.0.10.11
nodes.description: The second controller, so SBD-REPO01 keeps DNS and time if SBD-DC01 is down. chrony on REPO01 lists both.

nodes.name: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01
nodes.title: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 · 10.0.60.20
nodes.description: The Tier 1 administration seat from course 1.1, part 8 (rule A02). The only place SSH to SBD-REPO01 comes from, and where the course's evidence folder lives.

chapters.network: SBD-REPO01 is planned on VLAN 70. The domain controllers and SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 already run from earlier courses; no paths are shown until the server exists.
SBD-REPO01 is live on VLAN 70. It queries both domain controllers for DNS and time, and SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 reaches it over SSH 22; its HTTP listener waits for consumers that later courses build.
The first snapshot crosses by hand on approved media (no network path) and is checked on SBD-REPO01 before it is published. SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 keeps the catalog copy; no consumer is connected yet.
SBD-REPO01 tests the client configuration against itself. The Linux servers that will use it, SBD-SPLUNK01, SBD-NESSUS01 and SBD-WEB01, are built in later courses and are not shown.

The next snapshot crosses by hand on approved media and is promoted, then rolled back. SCC for Linux is staged on SBD-ADMIN-SRV01, SBD-REPO01 is scanned in place over SSH, and its record is collected there.
